$schema_note: AppRefer Support (help chat) strings shared by the iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native SDKs. Placeholders are {name}-style and filled by name. Plural keys ("plural": true) hold CLDR cardinal categories per language. Hand-over and AI answer text come from the server, not this table.

support.home.title.comment: Small title above the greeting on the help home. {app} = the app's display name. Used when the app sets no custom title.

support.home.greeting.named.comment: Big greeting on the help home when we know the customer's first name. Keep the wave emoji. Very short.

support.home.greeting.comment: Big greeting on the help home when we don't know the customer's name. Keep the wave emoji. Very short.

support.home.subtitle.comment: Line under the greeting on the help home.

support.home.continue.comment: Section label (shown in capitals) above the card that reopens the customer's latest open conversation.

support.home.quickHelp.comment: Section label (shown in capitals) above the quick-help topic tiles.

support.home.conversations.comment: Section label (shown in capitals) above the list of the customer's earlier conversations.

support.home.youPrefix.comment: Preview of the last message in a conversation when the customer sent it. {text} = the message preview.

support.replyTime.default.comment: Default reply time. It completes sentences such as 'We usually reply in {time}' and 'Usually replies in {time}', so it must fit after the word for 'in' in those translations (e.g. German 'unter einer Stunde').

support.presence.team.comment: Presence pill on the help home when no team names are set. {time} = reply time, e.g. 'under an hour'.

support.presence.one.comment: Presence pill when exactly one support person is named. {name} = their first name, {time} = reply time.

support.presence.many.comment: Presence pill when several people are named. {name} = first person's first name, {time} = reply time (e.g. 'under an hour').

support.presence.persona.comment: Presence pill when the app has an AI assistant and no named team. {persona} = the assistant's first name, {time} = reply time.

support.presence.personaWithTeam.en: {persona} replies instantly · {name} and the team in {time}
support.presence.personaWithTeam.comment: Presence pill with an AI assistant and a named person. {persona} = assistant's first name, {name} = person's first name, {time} = reply time.

support.composer.placeholder.home.comment: Placeholder in the message field on the help home.

support.composer.placeholder.persona.comment: Placeholder in the message field on the help home when an AI assistant answers. {name} = assistant's first name. 'Message' is a verb (write to).

support.composer.placeholder.thread.comment: Placeholder in the message field inside a conversation. Short noun/verb, like iMessage's field placeholder.

support.topic.billing.title.comment: Quick-help tile title. Also becomes the conversation subject. Short (fits half a phone width).

support.topic.billing.subtitle.comment: Quick-help tile subtitle under 'Billing & refunds'. Very short.

support.topic.billing.prompt.comment: Message field hint once the billing tile is picked.

support.topic.restore.title.comment: Quick-help tile title (getting a bought subscription back). Short.

support.topic.restore.subtitle.comment: Quick-help tile subtitle under 'Restore purchase'. Very short.

support.topic.restore.prompt.en: Which plan did you buy, and on which account?
support.topic.restore.prompt.comment: Message field hint once the restore tile is picked.

support.topic.bug.subtitle.comment: Quick-help tile subtitle under 'Report a bug'. Very short.

support.topic.bug.prompt.en: What went wrong? A screenshot helps.
support.topic.bug.prompt.comment: Message field hint once the bug tile is picked.

support.topic.idea.subtitle.comment: Quick-help tile subtitle under 'Suggest an idea' (we read every idea). Very short.

support.topic.idea.prompt.en: What would make the app better for you?
support.topic.idea.prompt.comment: Message field hint once the idea tile is picked.

support.thread.team.comment: Conversation header title when no named person has replied yet. {app} = app name.

support.thread.replyTime.comment: Conversation header subtitle. {time} = reply time, e.g. 'under an hour'.

support.thread.personaSubtitle.comment: Conversation header subtitle under the AI assistant's name. {app} = app name.

support.thread.sentNotice.en: Sent {time} · we'll notify you when the team replies
support.thread.sentNotice.comment: Small note under the customer's last message. {time} = clock time like 14:05.

support.thread.sentNoticeNoTime.en: Sent · we'll notify you when the team replies
support.thread.sentNoticeNoTime.comment: Same note when the send time is unknown.

support.thread.instantAnswer.comment: Label (shown in capitals with a ✦ before it) on an automatic answer card.

support.thread.handoff.person.comment: Pill after the AI assistant hands the conversation to a person. {name} = person's first name, {time} = reply time.

support.thread.handoff.team.en: Passed to the team · usually replies in {time}
support.thread.handoff.team.comment: Pill after the AI assistant hands the conversation to the team. {time} = reply time.

support.thread.quickReply.thanks.comment: Quick-reply chip; tapping it sends this exact text as the customer's message. Casual, keep the emoji.

support.thread.quickReply.another.comment: Quick-reply chip that focuses the message field.

support.thread.sending.comment: Under a message that is being sent.

support.thread.notSent.comment: Under a message that failed to send; tapping retries.

support.thread.loadFailed.comment: Shown when a conversation fails to load (followed by a Try again button).

support.thread.teamFallback.comment: Author name for a team reply that has no name.

support.conversation.defaultSubject.comment: Subject used for a conversation that has none.

support.ai.tag.comment: Tiny tag next to the AI assistant's name on every message it sends. 2-4 characters; use the usual local abbreviation for artificial intelligence (e.g. 'IA', 'KI', 'ИИ').

support.time.today.comment: Timestamp for a message sent today. {time} = clock time.

support.time.yesterday.comment: Timestamp for a message sent yesterday. {time} = clock time.

support.a11y.close.comment: Accessibility label for the close (X) button.

support.a11y.back.comment: Accessibility label for the back button.

support.a11y.send.comment: Accessibility label for the send button.

support.a11y.addScreenshot.comment: Accessibility label for the camera/plus button in the message bar.

support.a11y.addAnotherScreenshot.comment: Accessibility label for the + tile after attached screenshots.

support.a11y.removeScreenshot.comment: Accessibility label for the small X on an attached screenshot.

support.a11y.removeScreenshotNumbered.comment: Accessibility label for the X on the n-th attached screenshot. {number} = 1, 2, 3 or 4.

support.a11y.screenshot.comment: Accessibility label for a screenshot in a message.

support.a11y.screenshotNumbered.comment: Accessibility label for the n-th attached screenshot. {number} = 1, 2, 3 or 4.

support.a11y.closeScreenshot.comment: Accessibility label for the full-screen screenshot viewer background.

support.a11y.imageUnavailable.comment: Accessibility label when a screenshot can't be shown.

support.a11y.removeTopic.comment: Accessibility label for the X on the chosen topic chip.

support.a11y.aiAssistant.comment: Accessibility label read for the 'AI' tag.

support.a11y.newMessage.comment: Accessibility label for the message field on the help home.

support.a11y.retryMessage.comment: Accessibility label for a failed message that can be retried.

support.a11y.sendingMessage.comment: Accessibility label for a message being sent.

support.a11y.continueConversation.comment: Accessibility label for the Continue card. {subject} = conversation subject.

support.a11y.conversation.comment: Accessibility label for a row in the conversation list. {subject} = conversation subject.

support.a11y.unread.comment: Accessibility label for the unread badge. {count} = number of unread replies. PLURAL: give every CLDR cardinal category your language uses.

support.error.generic.comment: Generic error under the message bar or on a screen.

support.error.offline.en: Couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
support.error.offline.comment: Error when the device is offline or the server can't be reached.

support.error.loadFailed.comment: Error when the help home or a conversation can't load.

support.error.notSent.en: Your message wasn't sent. Try again.
support.error.notSent.comment: Error when starting a conversation fails.

support.error.upload.en: The screenshot didn't upload. Try again.
support.error.upload.comment: Error when a screenshot upload fails.

support.error.imageUnreadable.comment: Error when a picked photo can't be opened.

support.error.locked.en: Support isn't available until the device is unlocked. Try again.
support.error.locked.comment: Error when secure storage is locked (before the phone has been unlocked after a restart).

support.error.unavailable.en: Support isn't available right now. Try again.
support.error.unavailable.comment: Error when the help chat can't start (storage or setup problem).

support.error.tooLong.en: That message is too long. Try a shorter one.
support.error.tooLong.comment: Error when the message exceeds the size limit.

support.error.rateLimited.en: Too many messages. Wait a moment and try again.
support.error.rateLimited.comment: Error when the customer hits the rate limit.

support.notification.channel.comment: Android notification channel name for support reply notifications (shown in system settings).
